states.name: Georgia
states.asOf: Early voting closed Oct 30; detail as of Oct 26
states.source: Fox 5 Atlanta (citing the Georgia Secretary of State's unofficial turnout dashboard) and Atlanta News First
notes: Final total: "more than 2.7 million Georgians cast their ballots early" (Atlanta News First, updated Oct 31; no breakdown given).
As of Oct 26: 1,781,209 accepted ballots, 23.7% of 7,530,073 active voters: 1,698,469 in person and 82,740 absentee (Fox 5 Atlanta).
In-person early voting was 12% ahead of the same point in 2022 as of Oct 20, per the Secretary of State's office; absentee requests ran well below 2022.
Georgia does not register voters by party. A modeled split attributed to TargetSmart put early voters at about 54% Democratic and 41% Republican; that is an estimate, not an official count.
states.turnoutNote: Computed, not published: 2.7 million ballots divided by 7,530,073 active voters (the Oct 26 figure), so treat it as about 36%.
